name: ecc-cloud
description: Private cloud adaptation of ECC from alexpostnik/ECC: a workflow router with the original skills, agent guidance, and coding rules as supporting references.

author.name: Alex Post; upstream ECC by Affaan Mustafa and contributors

interface.longDescription: Use ECC's original workflows from your fork in a managed cloud conversation. The ECC entry skill routes planning, test-driven development, review, verification, and domain requests to a pinned collection of upstream skills and agent guidance. It uses the conversation's available tools. Native CLI hooks, automatic memory collection, and local MCP servers are not activated by this package.
defaultPrompt: Use ECC to inspect my project and plan the next change.
Use ECC's TDD workflow to implement this change.
Use ECC to review and verify the current changes.
